name: iati
label: IATI (International Aid)
description: International Aid Transparency Initiative — 1500+ NGOs and governments publish aid data

table_notes.iati_organisation: Publishing organisations (donors, implementers, NGOs) identified by their IATI org-ref and typed via the IATI OrganisationType codelist.
table_notes.iati_activity: Core project/programme record linking a reporting organisation to a set of transactions, budgets, and results; status and scope follow IATI Activity Status and Activity Scope codelists.
table_notes.iati_transaction: Individual financial flows (commitments, disbursements, expenditures, reimbursements) attached to an activity with provider and receiver organisations.
table_notes.iati_budget: Approved or indicative budget periods for an activity, used to compare planned spend against actual transactions over time.
table_notes.iati_result: Outcome and output results declared for an activity, with JSONB indicators storing target and actual values per reporting period.

iati_organisation.name: id
iati_organisation.description: Surrogate primary key for internal joins

iati_organisation.name: ref
iati_organisation.description: IATI organisation identifier (e.g. GB-CHC-1068839); globally unique per IATI standard

iati_organisation.name: name
iati_organisation.description: Multilingual organisation name; JSONB array of {lang, text} objects per IATI narrative element

iati_organisation.name: country
iati_organisation.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the organisation is registered

iati_activity.name: iati_identifier
iati_activity.description: Globally unique IATI activity identifier (reporting-org-ref + activity code, e.g. GB-1-201820)

iati_activity.name: reporting_org_id
iati_activity.description: Organisation responsible for publishing this activity record; references iati_organisation.id

iati_activity.name: title
iati_activity.description: Multilingual activity title; JSONB array of {lang, text} IATI narrative objects

iati_activity.name: description
iati_activity.description: Multilingual activity description; JSONB array of {type, lang, text} where type follows IATI DescriptionType codelist

iati_activity.name: activity_scope
iati_activity.description: IATI ActivityScope codelist indicating geographic coverage (1=Global, 3=Regional, 4=Multi-national, 5=National)

iati_activity.name: start_planned
iati_activity.description: Planned activity start date as declared in the publisher's IATI file

iati_activity.name: end_planned
iati_activity.description: Planned activity end date as declared in the publisher's IATI file

iati_activity.name: start_actual
iati_activity.description: Actual date the activity began implementation

iati_activity.name: end_actual
iati_activity.description: Actual date the activity was completed or closed

iati_activity.name: default_currency
iati_activity.description: ISO 4217 currency code applied to transactions that omit an explicit currency

iati_activity.name: last_updated
iati_activity.description: Timestamp when the publisher last updated this activity in their IATI data file

iati_transaction.name: id
iati_transaction.description: Surrogate primary key for internal joins

iati_transaction.name: activity_id
iati_transaction.description: Activity this financial flow belongs to; references iati_activity.id

iati_transaction.name: transaction_type
iati_transaction.description: IATI TransactionType codelist (1=Incoming Funds, 2=Outgoing Commitment, 3=Disbursement, 4=Expenditure, 11=Credit Guarantee)

iati_transaction.name: transaction_date
iati_transaction.description: Date the financial transaction was executed or recorded

iati_transaction.name: value
iati_transaction.description: Transaction amount in the specified currency (positive for all types per IATI convention)

iati_transaction.name: currency
iati_transaction.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this transaction (overrides activity default_currency if set)

iati_transaction.name: provider_org_id
iati_transaction.description: Organisation providing the funds in this transaction; references iati_organisation.id

iati_transaction.name: receiver_org_id
iati_transaction.description: Organisation receiving the funds in this transaction; references iati_organisation.id

iati_transaction.name: description
iati_transaction.description: Multilingual narrative explaining the purpose of this transaction; JSONB array of {lang, text} objects

iati_transaction.name: sector_code
iati_transaction.description: DAC 5-digit sector code or IATI SectorVocabulary code indicating thematic purpose of the spend

iati_transaction.name: country_code
iati_transaction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the recipient country for this transaction

iati_budget.name: id
iati_budget.description: Surrogate primary key for internal joins

iati_budget.name: activity_id
iati_budget.description: Activity this budget period belongs to; references iati_activity.id

iati_budget.name: period_start
iati_budget.description: Start date of the budget period (typically aligned to fiscal year)

iati_budget.name: period_end
iati_budget.description: End date of the budget period (typically aligned to fiscal year)

iati_budget.name: value
iati_budget.description: Budgeted amount for this period in the specified currency

iati_budget.name: currency
iati_budget.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this budget value (overrides activity default_currency if set)

iati_result.name: id
iati_result.description: Surrogate primary key for internal joins

iati_result.name: activity_id
iati_result.description: Activity this result framework entry belongs to; references iati_activity.id

iati_result.name: title
iati_result.description: Multilingual result title; JSONB array of {lang, text} IATI narrative objects

iati_result.name: description
iati_result.description: Multilingual result description; JSONB array of {lang, text} IATI narrative objects

iati_result.name: indicators
iati_result.description: JSONB array of indicator objects each with {title, measure, ascending, baseline, period[{target, actual}]} per IATI schema

short_description: International Aid Transparency Initiative — 1500+ NGOs and governments publish aid data
long_description: IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative) 2.03 defines the open data standard for publishing development cooperation activities. The schema covers reporting organizations, activities with titles/descriptions/status, individual financial transactions (commitments, disbursements, expenditures), budget breakdowns by period, and result indicators with target/actual values.
when_to_use: Use for donor management systems, project management tools for NGOs, aid coordination platforms, or M&E systems. Over 1,700 publishers including USAID, UKAID, World Bank, and UNICEF publish IATI data. Many bilateral donors require IATI-compatible reporting as a grant condition. Required for integration with d-portal.org, the IATI Datastore, and DevTracker.
